name: Horse Lord
summary: A mounted wilderness warrior whose combat style, companion, and supernatural bond are devoted to a riding beast.

features.name: Mounted Bond
features.summary: Choose a legal riding companion; effective Druid level equals Ranger level –3 and gain +2 Handle Animal and Ride with it.
features.scaling: effective Druid level equals Ranger level –3

features.name: Strong Bond
features.summary: Your mount's effective Druid level becomes equal to your Ranger level.

features.name: Spiritual Bond
features.summary: Grant your mount temporary hit points equal to Ranger level and optionally share its damage while within 30 feet.
